Thank you for your review. I’m sorry to hear about your recent experience regarding your test results.
The only time our reception team are able to give out test results is if they are normal. If a result has come back that you need further treatment to resolve, a receptionist would not be able to inform you of this as they are not medically trained to do so, and this could cause complications further down the line. This is why we request patients to make an appointment with the doctor to discuss their results. 
We aren’t able to simply transfer a call through to the doctor as there is a very high chance they are in the middle of another appointment with another patient who also needs their help. Booking an appointment also gives the doctor time to study your medical history and the test results so they have a clearer understanding of your issue. If a patient is unhappy to wait for a doctor to call them back, our team are trained to direct them to an alternative service where they are able to get medical treatment a little bit quicker, like a hospital or a walk-in centre.
